nom: belif Super Drops Niacinamide and Vitamin C Golden Glow Serum

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily to combination skin reports the product made her skin super oily and would not recommend it for that skin type.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation and good tolerance, including one with sensitive, dry skin who says it never irritated her, while another sensitive-skin reviewer found it merely inoffensive without irritation or notable radiance.
segments.dry: One reviewer with very sensitive, dry skin reports the serum kept her face hydrated daily without irritation.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature or aging skin report they use it daily, like how it feels, and credit it with bringing life and glow back to their complexion.
segments.combination: One reviewer describes it as unsuitable for oily to combination skin because it made her skin oily.

concerns.aging: Reviewers who mention aging or mature skin describe it as a favorite daily product that brings glow and life back to the complexion; none report anti-aging effects like fewer lines.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers looking for hydration report the serum keeps skin hydrated and adds moisture alongside the glow, with one sensitive-dry-skin user saying it never failed to keep her face hydrated.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with pale, redness-prone skin in her 50s used it regularly and saw no improvement in redness and would not repurchase.
concerns.barrier: No reviewer specifically discusses barrier repair; one review notes the formula contains skin-mimicking lipids meant to seal in moisture, described as a texture observation rather than a personal barrier outcome.
concerns.spots: No reviewer describes an effect on dark spots or discoloration.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers who state they do not normally break out report new breakouts of small whiteheads with repeated use, including one who tried it four separate times with the same result; most other reviewers report no breakouts at all.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily to combination skin reports the product made her skin noticeably oilier and advises against it for that skin type.

aspects.libelle: Thick, sticky, hard to absorb texture
Small amount goes a long way

I love the idea of this product, but it made my skin super oily. If you have super oily to combination skin..I would not recommend this product.

extraits.titre: It's fine but not a repeat for me
extraits.texte: Have pale, redness prone skin and am in my 50's and feel I need a lot of this serum. It's fine but I can't say I've seen any improvements with regular usage. With all the powerhouse serums out there, this won't be a repeat for me.

extraits.titre: obsessed with this and other belif products
extraits.texte: I'm very sensitive so it was a joy to discover this one suits me so well. I had bad reactions to other vitamin C products, but all the belif ones have been awesome. I've used it every morning for several weeks and I like the results. Very subtle glowy effect. I love the scent of their products, too.

I have gone through 4 bottles of this now and that never happens for me. I am a person that is constantly trying all the new releases and never return to any one product, rarely. This is perfection in a bottle. I wear this nonstop for my no makeup days. It gives my skin a gorgeous glow without looking like the tin man and also keeps it hydrated. If you're looking for something to hydrate, give you a subtle glow that you can wear alone or under makeup, this is it. I rave about this to everyone who mentions wanting to start on their skincare journey but doesn't want to start with 5 steps. If you use just one product every morning, let it be this. I have very sensitive, dry skin and this has never irritated or failed to keep my face hydrated. The only way this could be improved is if they made a version with SPF in it.

I bought this during the 21 days of beauty event. I absolutely love this! instantly made my skin radiant. after a month of Use, skin feels super soft and complexion is even and brighter. this is great for aging skin to bring life back into your complexion.
